title: The Melting Arctic Lifeline for Russia’s Shadow Fleet
gist: CSIS Futures Lab finds Russia's Arctic crude exports ($18.8B since Feb 2022) are concentrated in a few chokepoints: two FSOs (Umba, Kola) handled ~53% and three fixed sites ~77% (~$14.5B), while the shadow fleet depends on ~100 ice-class tankers and eight aging nuclear icebreakers. It recommends targeting icebreaker construction/maintenance supply chains, accelerating the EU LNG-tanker services ban (due Jan 1, 2027), and public maritime-domain-awareness exposure of dark STS transfers.
